name: Parcel Spatial Representation Definition
abstract: The WA cadastral parcel-specific extension of the generic spatial representation definition pattern. Adds the jurisdictional source basis (rule type, source authority type, and verbatim source statement) needed to trace a parcel's vertical boundary back to a title, plan, statute, Crown Grant, strata statement, or other approved jurisdictional rule.

sources.title: Summary of Western Australian Parcel Representation Examples (2.5D liminal proposal)
